claim_boundary: Internal head-only mechanism evidence on an exposed 512-complex development holdout. It is not downstream, blind-test, temporal, or scaling evidence.

decision.reason: The frozen scientific gate failed on contact-loss reduction, matched-ranking-loss reduction, and centering-loss behavior. Average-precision gains from this run are additionally invalid because the executed evaluator resolved tied scores in sampler order.

evaluator_correction.problem: The executed AP implementation used stable item-level ordering inside tied score groups. Because positives precede negatives in the deterministic sampler, a constant score could produce AP=1 instead of prevalence.
evaluator_correction.resolution: The corrected implementation computes precision and recall increments only at distinct score thresholds and is invariant to permutations within ties. No corrected AP is backfilled into the frozen audit.
